# The Omega Group

> Luxury interior design and turnkey execution studio based in Gurgaon, India.

## What we do

The Omega Group designs and delivers residential and commercial interiors — full-home and apartment interiors, villa interiors, modular kitchens, bespoke furniture, and office & commercial fit-outs. All projects are turnkey: design, material procurement, and on-site execution are managed by one team, not separate designers and contractors.

## Facts

- Founded: June 2022
- Experience: 10+ years (combined team experience)
- Projects delivered: 90+
- On-time delivery rate: 90%
- Quality control checks per project: 70+
- Custom furniture designs completed: 290+
- Starting price, full-home turnkey interior design: ₹15 Lakhs+
- Price range: ₹₹₹₹ (premium/luxury)

## Location & service area

Headquartered on Main Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram, Haryana, India. Serves Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, including Dwarka Expressway, DLF, Sushant Lok, Sohna Road, New Gurgaon, and Manesar.

Address: Plot S4 & S5, Main Dwarka Expressway, Near Daulatabad Chowk, opp. Pillar 109, Gurugram, Haryana 122006, India

## Differentiators

- Single accountable team for design and execution — no separate designer/contractor coordination required by the client.
- Headquartered directly on Dwarka Expressway, not a satellite office covering the area remotely.
- Itemised quoting — costs are shown before work begins.
- 70+ quality-control checks built into the execution process, not left to a single final inspection.
